senses.sense_definition: To smile broadly, often parting the lips to show the teeth, typically expressing amusement or pleasure.

examples.text: The little boy began to <w>grin</w> from ear to ear when he saw the giant ice cream cone.

target_lang_translations.fr: Le petit garçon a commencé à <w>sourire</w> jusqu'aux oreilles en voyant l'énorme cornet de glace.

examples.text: Why do you <w>grin</w> like that every time I mention his name?

target_lang_definitions.tr: Dişleri gösterecek şekilde genişçe gülmek, genellikle eğlence veya keyif belirtir.
target_lang_definitions.es: Sonreír ampliamente, a menudo mostrando los dientes, expresando diversión o placer.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Оскаливать зубы подобно рычащему животному, часто из-за боли или гнева.
